verdict.rationale: Metorial is a hosted MCP and integration platform that stores sessions, traces, tool calls and logs, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents retention periods, deletion APIs, or purge controls. Per-environment logs and activity review are adjacent features and do not show that a user can control retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
